run_migrate_tips_cli: run the migrate_tips CLI to convert <Tip> blocks to [!TIP]/[!WARNING] blockquotes in a docs directory
convert_file_tips: convert a single markdown or py file by replacing <Tip> and <Tip warning> blocks with admonition syntax
convert_file_recursive: convert all .md, .mdx, and .py files recursively in a directory from <Tip> blocks to blockquote admonitions
convert_single_file: convert a single .md file containing <Tip> blocks to [!TIP] blockquote format
convert_warning_tips: convert <Tip warning> blocks to [!WARNING] blockquote format in documentation files
